A different way to explore AIFL

Four new structures.

A journal, a guided choice, an expandable prospectus and a visual map.

05

Campus Journal

New direction

A magazine-style front page with a centred masthead, a lead story, a tall photograph and a separate course index. The layout reads like a compact institutional publication.

Structure
Magazine masthead · Three-part front page · Course index
Character
Editorial · Informed · Established
Best for
An institution with a story to tell
Explore design
06

Guided Pathway

New direction

An interactive starting point built around a question. Visitors choose an interest and see relevant courses immediately, with practical answers below.

Structure
Interest selector · Live course results · Question-led support
Character
Supportive · Personal · Guided
Best for
Helping undecided visitors take a first step

07

Bold Prospectus

New direction

A strong typographic prospectus with a permanent navigation rail. Expandable course rows put detail on demand, framed by an orange introduction and crisp rules.

Structure
Vertical navigation · Expandable rows · Type-led composition
Character
Assertive · Structured · Distinctive
Best for
A memorable identity with quick course exploration
Explore design
08

Course Atlas

New direction

A visual map of study areas. Unequal coloured panels replace the conventional hero and list; visitors open course details directly from the map.

Structure
Spatial course map · In-place details · Asymmetric composition
Character
Open · Visual · Exploratory
Best for
Browsing by interest without a long page of courses
